title: Technoir Wallpaper Engine Pipeline Schema
description: Render pipeline configurations. Each property name is the pipeline label used by the engine.

^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$.description: Render pipeline configuration. Shader interfaces and pipeline layout are inspected from the shader by the engine; this configuration describes fixed-function state and information Naga cannot determine from the shader alone.

shader.description: Path to the WGSL or WESL shader file relative to the plugin's shaders/ directory.

entry_points.description: Explicit shader entry points. Omit this when the shader contains exactly one entry point for each required stage; the engine will select those automatically.

vertex.description: Vertex-stage entry point. Normally omitted when Naga finds exactly one vertex entry point.

fragment.description: Fragment-stage entry point. Normally omitted when Naga finds exactly one fragment entry point.
